record.body:
## Description

dashboard-status parses the contract dashboard view and lists efforts the app does not show. Rebuild it on dashboard_model.load_snapshot so each line is an effort the app shows, with the same running, ready, and needs-you counts. Keep printing nothing when there is no store or the CLI fails.

payload.title: Build the status line from the app snapshot

record.subject: status-line-from-snapshot
